name: mcp-server
description: Serve this gateway's tools over MCP — per-user sha256 bearer tokens, JSON-RPC dispatch derived from TOOL_REGISTRY, and an OAuth 2.1 AS (RFC 7591 DCR + PKCE S256) with both .well-known documents.
notes: Declared IN PLACE: convex/mcp*.ts stay at the convex root because Convex derives api paths from file paths — moving them under convex/features/ would rename api.mcp.* repo-wide (the trap documented in convex/features/byok/index.ts). The three tables are inline in convex/schema.ts (the byok precedent), not a features/*/tables.ts. The tool catalog is the seam: dispatch is derived from convex/toolRegistry.ts + convex/toolHandlers.ts, declared in deps.shared — swap those two and the server exposes a different tool set with no change here. Next routes (/mcp, /oauth/*, /.well-known/*) are listed in slice.contract.ts provides.routes, following api-compat. Mirror of mcp-client: this slice SERVES tools, that one CONSUMES them (loop guard: derived mcp-client tools are never re-exported here).
